_: Ceilings for UniChat on CI devices (scripts/mobile-perf.mjs), one set per profile. android: API 35, google_apis, x86_64 with KVM, the release APK of the production config built with UNICHAT_PERF_MARKS=1; every PR that reaches the binary measures apkMB, coldStartTtidMs, coldStartJsBootMs and coldStartFirstScreenMs (mobile-verify.yml › android-smoke: one untimed launch, a fixed compile state, then ten cold starts each on a settled CPU, their median gated); coldStartTtidMs is Android's TotalTime, the activity's first frame, which the app holds until it lifts the splash right before its first-screen mark, so it times the first screen plus ~150 ms, not the splash; the nightly measures coldStartInboxMs, scrollJankyPercent, scrollP90FrameMs and memoryPssMB with the staging account (chat-mobile-verify.yml › android). android-2gb: the same APK on API 35 with 2 GB of RAM, the low-end leg of the nightly matrix (chat-mobile-verify.yml › android-matrix). ios-simulator: the Release simulator build, timed to the marks it writes to its documents (mobile-verify.yml › ios-release). A profile listed in `provisional` still has the ceilings set 2026-10-22 before any run measured this app: they catch a gross regression (a doubled start, a frozen scroll), not a small one. ios-simulator's two start ceilings are the exception: its first measured runs (2026-10-23) all sat above the guesses, which tighten (it only lowers) could never start from, so they were set once to the worst of five runs + 15 %; the profile stays provisional until tighten runs. android's three start ceilings are the second exception (UNI-2142, 2026-10-23): the guesses gated the same moment twice, TotalTime at 3000 and the first screen at 6000, and the TotalTime one failed about one clean run in nine (3092 and 3329 over 25 jobs, 2026-10-22/23; same commit 2056 vs 2748), which tighten could never raise from, as it reads only green runs and only lowers; they were set once to the worst median of those 25 jobs + 15 % (TotalTime 3329 → 3829, first screen 3073 → 3534, js-boot 1799 → 2069), a gross-regression guard: with ~22 % between-run noise on this emulator no single run catches +30 %. The profile stays provisional until tighten runs on five runs of the settled measurement. After five green runs of its job, `node scripts/mobile-perf.mjs tighten --profile <name> --write <the runs' unichat-perf-* files>` sets each ceiling to the worst run + 15 % (the emulator is noisy) and takes the profile off the list, in one commit that quotes the runs (audit perf-budgets-uncalibrated: a profile still on the list after provisionalUntil turns scripts/mobile-perf.test.mjs red, so a guess cannot pass for a budget for ever); then they only go down, and one goes up only in the commit that adds the weight, saying why. The emulator renders without a GPU: frame numbers are for comparison between builds, not a claim about a phone.
